name: 高帮白线车缝板鞋款
description: 高帮板鞋白线车缝配白色橡胶包头，夏季清凉三色可选

styleLock.direction: cool casual sneaker ecommerce detail-page system
styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF for packshots and color cards, light grey matte card fields #EFEFF2 for info and scene blocks, saturated electric-blue #2B6BE4 section bands, and one reserved blue-to-violet gradient #2B6BE4 to #5B3FE0 used only on the opening claim panel
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright cool studio lighting, front-left key at 6000K with soft fill and gentle rim, crisp soft contact shadows grounding the soles, controlled highlights on rubber and stitching, no blown speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte white acrylic sweep #FFFFFF, light grey matte board #EFEFF2 for flat lays and infographics, light concrete paving #D9D9D6 for the outdoor scene
styleLock.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif for every headline; short Chinese headlines 28-48pt, uppercase tracked English micro-labels 10-14pt, no mixed families
styleLock.iconSystem: solid electric-blue square badge icons #2B6BE4 each holding one large white Chinese character plus one uppercase English micro-label, with thin blue outline chips #2B6BE4 for short labels
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 front hero angle and constant product scale across the whole set; the pair arranged toe-forward with the left shoe leading; the shoe never clipped by the frame
noDrift: no magenta used as a background field
no change of the product silhouette between shots
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool casual sneaker e-commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, saturated electric blue #2B6BE4, light grey #EFEFF2 and charcoal text #22262B with a single magenta accent #FF4FA3 plus one reserved blue-to-violet hero gradient #2B6BE4 to #5B3FE0; cool color temperature around 6000K; bright front-left key light with soft fill and crisp soft contact shadows grounding the soles; seamless white sweeps, light grey matte card fields, bold electric-blue section bands and thin blue outline chips; one modern geometric sans-serif for all headlines with uppercase tracked English micro-labels and solid blue square character badges holding one white character each; stable slight 3/4 front hero angle at constant product scale, the pair arranged toe-forward with the left shoe leading and balanced composition margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no magenta used as a background field, no change of the product silhouette between shots.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规、轮廓清晰
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level with a slight 3/4 front angle, both shoes fully visible and not clipped
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, front-left key at 6000K with soft fill, soft contact shadow
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A pair of the high-top sneakers placed side by side, the left shoe half a step forward, photographed straight-on at eye level with a slight 3/4 front angle, both shoes fully visible and never clipped by the frame. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a front-left key at 6000K and soft fill, one soft contact shadow grounding both soles. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF, no props. The pair occupies 60-70% of the frame with an even breathing margin on all sides. 8K, commercial footwear e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no people, no watermark, no fake logo, no brand mark on the tongue patch, no extra text, no decorative elements, no gradient background, no cut-off edges, no floating shoes without contact shadow.

shots.intent: 一秒说清核心利益，主图一秒法则
shots.camera: low angle looking slightly upward so the toe caps and midsole read large, one shoe turning outward
shots.lighting: cool studio lighting, front-left key at 6000K with a soft rim from behind, crisp contact shadow
shots.background: smooth blue-to-violet gradient #2B6BE4 to #5B3FE0 with two small accent shapes in #FF4FA3
shots.props: two small soft geometric accent shapes in #FF4FA3 kept to the frame edges
shots.textZone: top 25% band carries one headline 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF plus one short benefit line 「{selling_point_1}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a low angle looking slightly upward so the toe caps and the midsole stripe read large, the pair angled with one shoe turning outward and filling 50-60% of the frame. Cool studio lighting, front-left key at 6000K with a soft rim from behind and a crisp contact shadow. Background is a smooth blue-to-violet gradient from #2B6BE4 to #5B3FE0 with two small soft geometric accent shapes in #FF4FA3 kept at the frame edges. The top 25% band carries one headline 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF and one short benefit line 「{selling_point_1}」, both kept short and readable. Negative: no more than one claim, no dense body text, no invented performance or comfort data, no watermark, no fake logo, no props covering the shoes, no cut-off toe cap.

shots.intent: 放大夏季鞋内闷热、不透气的日常困扰
shots.camera: matched split-screen framing from a high 45-degree angle looking down, identical on both panels
shots.lighting: left panel flat and airless; right panel cool and airy, identical key direction on both panels
shots.background: light grey matte board #EFEFF2 on both panels
shots.props: left panel only: one pair of generic closed shoes left on a dull warm hallway floor as the pain symbol
shots.textZone: one short label per panel, 「{callout_1}」 on the left and 「{callout_2}」 on the right in #22262B
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen, two matched panels with identical camera, crop and key-light direction. Left panel: a pair of generic closed everyday shoes left on a dull warm hallway floor under flat airless light with a faint heat haze, conveying stuffy sweaty feet, no people in frame. Right panel: {product} on a clean light grey matte board #EFEFF2 under cool airy light. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Both panels are shot from the same high 45-degree angle looking down. One short label per panel, 「{callout_1}」 on the left and 「{callout_2}」 on the right in #22262B. {product} occupies 40-50% of the right panel as the clear contrast subject. Negative: no visible faces, no bare feet, no deformed hands or feet, no fabricated statistics or temperature numbers, no invented test data, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 用清晰可见的车线与鞋眼证明做工与版型
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro shot from a clean 90-degree side profile, f/3.5, nearest stitch line tack sharp
shots.lighting: raking side light from the left at 6000K revealing thread and surface grain, soft controlled highlight
shots.whitespace: minimal, detail is the whole point
shots.textZone: one tiny annotation label 「{callout_1}」 in #22262B at the lower corner
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom on the upper seam where the contrast light topstitching runs beside the row of metal lace eyelets. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a clean 90-degree side profile at f/3.5 with shallow depth of field, the nearest stitch line tack sharp and the far end falling off softly. Raking side light from the left at 6000K revealing thread texture and the fine surface grain, soft controlled highlight, no blown speculars. Neutral light grey matte board background #EFEFF2. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame with a minimal breathing margin, the stitch texture is the whole point. One tiny annotation label 「{callout_1}」 in #22262B at the lower corner. Negative: no blurry subject, no invented material or weave, no duplicated eyelets, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no plastic-looking surface, no dust or scratches.

shots.displayName: 夏日街头休闲出行场景

shots.background: light concrete paving #D9D9D6 on a bright summer street with a low kerb line
shots.props: a folded canvas tote resting on the ground and a soft railing shadow, neither covering the shoes

Photographed at eye level at a slight 3/4 walking angle with a candid handheld feel, the footwear clearly the subject and never covered, occupying 40-50% of the frame mid-stride. Cool natural daylight from the left at 5500K with open-shade fill and long soft contact shadows. Props: a folded canvas tote resting on the ground and a soft railing shadow, only two props, none covering the shoes. Negative: no visible face, no distorted ankles or toes, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no cluttered background, no duplicated background objects, no floating feet without contact shadow.

shots.lighting: even flat high-key lighting at 6000K, no dramatic shadow, soft contact shadow under the sole
shots.background: light grey matte board #EFEFF2 with a white #FFFFFF card field behind the callouts
shots.props: thin leader lines ending in one solid electric-blue square badge icon
shots.textZone: three callout labels with thin leader lines along the outer profile 「{callout_1}」, 「{callout_2}」, 「{callout_3}」 in #22262B beside one solid blue square badge icon #2B6BE4
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic structure screen for {product}, photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle with the shoe resting on its side so the full profile silhouette, the rubber toe bumper, the midsole stripe and the outsole edge all read clearly. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even flat high-key lighting at 6000K with no dramatic shadow and a soft contact shadow under the sole. Background light grey matte board #EFEFF2 with a white #FFFFFF card field behind the callouts and one solid electric-blue square badge icon #2B6BE4 holding a single white character plus an uppercase English micro-label. Three thin leader lines end in short callout labels 「{callout_1}」, 「{callout_2}」 and 「{callout_3}」 in #22262B along the outer profile, pointing at the toe bumper, the midsole stripe and the outsole edge. The shoe occupies 60-70% of the frame as the structured centerpiece. Negative: no dense body text, no tiny unreadable text, no invented test data, no measurement numbers, no certification marks, no watermark, no fake logo, no warped straight lines, no duplicated sole layers.

shots.lighting: cool even studio light at 6000K in all three columns, soft contact shadows, no lighting drift

shots.props: three light grey #EFEFF2 swatch chips, one above each column
shots.textZone: one short label above each column, 「{callout_1}」, 「{callout_2}」 and 「{callout_3}」 in #22262B
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce variant screen for {product}, three equal columns on one card grid, each column showing the same high-top sneaker in a different colorway: matte black #1A1A1C, off-white #F2F2F2 and light silver grey #BDC1C6. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Every column uses the identical front 3/4 hero angle, the identical scale and the identical lighting, so only the color differs. Cool even studio light at 6000K with soft contact shadows. Clean white #FFFFFF card fields with a light grey #EFEFF2 swatch chip above each column and one short label per column, 「{callout_1}」, 「{callout_2}」 and 「{callout_3}」 in #22262B. provenance.notes: 由 8 屏 800x1200 长图切片提炼；已剥离原圆形舌标 logo、原中文与英文营销文案、年份与季节标注词、具体尺码数字与规格表内容、二维码与会员贴图、蓝色方块字标的具体文字，产品一律以 {product} 占位，仅保留可复用视觉语法：高帮板鞋形态、白线车缝与浅色橡胶包头特征、三色卡列、蓝色块面与方块字标图标系统、冷调棚拍光线。源图性别文案不一致（一屏标男鞋、一屏标女鞋、尺码 34-40），按尺码区间与主体形态落位女鞋。
